name: renderandrank.com

scripts.pages:deploy: astro build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=renderandrank-com
scripts.test:entities: esbuild tests/entityMatch.test.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=local/entityMatch.test.cjs && esbuild tests/assumptions.test.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=local/assumptions.test.cjs && node --test local/entityMatch.test.cjs local/assumptions.test.cjs
scripts.dev:local: npm run pages:build && npm run db:migrate:local && npm run pages:dev

description: Marketing site for **Render and Rank** — a local SEO / AEO-GEO agency. Built as a fast, mostly-static [Astro](https://astro.build) site with a handful of React islands, deployed on **Cloudflare Pages** with a serverless contact pipeline backed by **Cloudflare D1** and **Resend**.
